1. Grading Rubrics & Penalties (Oposiciones Andalucía 2026)

A. Written Topic (Theme) Rubric
  • Expression & presentation (10%): structure – index, intro, development, conclusion, bibliography (2%); written expression (5%); clean, clear, orderly presentation (3%).
  • Depth, concreteness & updating (60%).
  • Critical, well-founded judgement (10%): normative & epistemological argumentation.
  • Exemplification & application (7%).
  • Logical, ordered sequence (7%).
  • References (6%): more than three normative/bibliographical citations.
B. Teaching Programme (document + defence)
  • Document (3 pts): justification 3%, written expression 3%, contextualisation 3%, structure with 13 elements 21%.
  • Oral defence (7 pts): 16 criteria, e.g. curricular concretion 6%, diversity 7%, evaluation 9%, oral expression 11%, closing 7%.
  • ⚠ -10 pts: any unit without at least one Learning Situation; fewer than 12 units; not own work; not Times New Roman 12 single-spaced; not submitted online.
  • ⚠ -5 pts: over 60 DIN A4 pages; no index of units. -1 pt per missing ID datum on the cover (max. 4).
C. Spelling & General Penalties (Anexos VII–VIII)
  • 1 falta: -0,5 • 2: -1,5 • 3: -2,5 • 4: -4,0 pts.
  • 5+ faltas: -10 pts. Missing or wrong accents count; a repeated mistake counts once. Also applies to the board during the unit defence.
  • -10 pts (topic & practical): identifying marks (incl. not writing both sides / vertically), no Arabic page numbers, sheets not provided, illegible, topic not drawn, more than one topic, topic number/title missing, wrong language.
  • -10 pts (unit defence): unit not the one chosen after the draw.

2. Legal Framework & Hierarchy (Andalusia) — highest to lowest rank

1. Constitution

Spanish Constitution (1978), approved by Parliament and ratified by referendum.

2. Organic Acts & Acts

L.O. 8/1985 (LODE) • L.O. 2/2006 (LOE) amended by L.O. 3/2020 (LOMLOE) • Act 17/2007 (LEA – Education in Andalusia).

3. Royal Decrees (Council of Ministers)

R.D. 217/2022 (ESO) • R.D. 243/2022 (Bachillerato).

4. Decrees (Junta de Andalucía)

D. 102/2023 (ESO) • D. 103/2023 (Bachillerato) • D. 327/2010 (IES regulations) amended by D. 483/2026.

5. Orders (Consejería)

Orders 30/5/2023 (ESO & Bachillerato) amended by Order 31/8/2026 • Order 20/8/2010 (IES organisation) amended by Order 31/8/2026.

6. Resolutions & Instructions

Issued by the competent administrative bodies: annual implementation and practical application.

A lower-ranking provision may not contradict a higher one; competence, speciality and subject-matter scope must also be respected.

3. Document Library — complete text (click a document to browse it)

Academy notes are in English and official documents in Spanish, so search in the language of the document (e.g. "evaluation criteria" or "criterios de evaluación"). The long BOE/BOJA texts include the full articles and the parts relevant to English (Lengua Extranjera); the other subjects' curricula are not included. Three annexes whose PDF text could not be read directly (Lengua Extranjera ESO and Bachillerato, horario de Bachillerato) were read with OCR: tables may appear with their columns mixed, so check the original page shown in each result.
